list.name: Marcos Lopes
list.description: Product Designer | UX/UI Designer | Design System
list.body: I had the opportunity to work alongside Pedro on a highly complex project, and he stood out not only for his proactivity but also for his excellence as a developer. His delivery speed is impressive, always maintaining a high level of quality. Furthermore, he has a keen eye for usability, ensuring that each solution is functional and intuitive. We had countless conversations about flows and choosing the best components for different scenarios, which demonstrates his commitment to user experience. Pedro is also an extremely collaborative professional, always in a good mood and contributing to a light and productive work environment.

list.name: Renato Davoli
list.body: Excellent developer. I had the opportunity to participate in the same project as him, where he stood out for his agility, code quality, great communication, and knowledge sharing among colleagues. Our project had several critical points where Pedro's knowledge and agility were essential for us to achieve our goals.
list.description: Software Developer | Salesforce Developer | Java | Kotlin | Node | Spring | Micronaut | React | QA | Automation | 1x AWS | 1x Salesforce Certified

list.name: Pedro Henrique Goes
list.body: I had the privilege of working with Pedro in my first professional experience. From the beginning, he showed himself to be very dedicated and open to conversations and discussions about various subjects. Throughout this period, he maintained a fast pace in his deliveries, being very efficient and acting as a strong support to help other colleagues. I could rely on his front-end knowledge to understand screens and interfaces to guide me regarding the system's needs. In addition, his relaxed behavior made the work environment lighter for everyone in the group, easing the difficulties and unforeseen events we encountered during the project.
list.description: Backend Developer | Spring Boot | Node.js | Mobile Developer | React Native | Bachelor in Computer Engineering/UFES

list.name: Amanda Castro
list.description: Full Stack Engineer | React | Node | Java | UX/UI Designer | Content Creator
list.body: Pedro is an excellent developer and a very proactive professional. He manages to complete tasks quickly while still maintaining quality. Personally, he is very easy to deal with, extremely focused and organized with his responsibilities, and brings a sense of lightness to the work environment. It was excellent collaborating with him.

list.name: Joao Guilherme Oliveira
list.body: Pedro is an excellent professional, both for his technical ability and his day-to-day partnership. I had the opportunity to work with him on developing the loan flow for the Vivo app, where the quality and consistency of his frontend deliveries were remarkable. He also demonstrates a great mastery of React, which directly reflects in the way he builds well-structured solutions. Besides the technical aspect, he stands out greatly for his human side. He is an accessible person, knows how to work in a team, and contributes to a lighter and more collaborative environment. I have complete confidence in recommending him to any team looking for a reliable, proactive frontend developer who adds value to deliveries.
